sentences.en: I'm very sorry about what happened, first of all.
sentences.zh: 首先，对于发生的一切，我深表歉意。

sentences.en: Second of all, can you tell me how it started?
sentences.zh: 其次，你能告诉我这一切是怎么开始的吗？

sentences.en: Yes, yes.
sentences.zh: 好的，好的。

sentences.en: My wife and I and our two daughters live in Kibbutz Nachalos, which is a beautiful community on the border with Gaza.
sentences.zh: 我和我妻子以及我们的两个女儿住在纳哈洛斯基布兹（Kibbutz Nachalos），这是一个位于加沙边境的美丽社区。

sentences.en: And we are very proud and still are to be members of this community.
sentences.zh: 我们一直为能成为这个社区的一员感到非常自豪，现在依然如此。

sentences.en: Yesterday morning at 6 a.m., we heard a whistle, and we realized that bombs are falling.
sentences.zh: 昨天早上6点，我们听到了一声哨响，意识到炸弹落下来了。

sentences.en: We are very attuned to these kinds of things, and actually in every house in our community, there is what we call a safe room, which is a room that is built of very strong concrete
sentences.zh: 我们对这类事情非常敏感，事实上，我们社区的每栋房子里都有所谓的“安全屋”，那是一个用非常坚固的混凝土建造的房间，

sentences.en: and has a special kind of door that is supposed to withstand the fall of mortars and rockets, and that's usually where the children sleep.
sentences.zh: 还有一种特殊的门，旨在抵御迫击炮和火箭弹的袭击，孩子们通常就睡在那里。

sentences.en: We just ran to the safe room, closed the window, closed the door, and we just waited for it to be over.
sentences.zh: 我们立刻跑进安全屋，关上窗户，关上门，然后就在那里等待一切结束。

sentences.en: But then, gunfire very close, and it became closer and closer.
sentences.zh: 但随后，枪声非常近，而且越来越近。

sentences.en: And that's when we realized we're in a different kind of event.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，我们意识到我们正处于一种完全不同的境况中。

sentences.en: And we realized that there are terrorists inside our neighborhood and at some point outside our window.
sentences.zh: 我们意识到恐怖分子就在我们的社区里，甚至一度就在我们的窗外。

sentences.en: We could hear them talk.
sentences.zh: 我们能听到他们说话。

sentences.en: We could hear them, you know, shooting their guns at our house, at our windows.
sentences.zh: 我们能听到他们，你知道，对着我们的房子、对着我们的窗户开枪。

sentences.en: There was no military anywhere in sight.
sentences.zh: 视线范围内根本看不到任何军队。

sentences.en: And at that moment, we realized that we are here alone.
sentences.zh: 那一刻，我们意识到我们孤立无援。

sentences.en: We are going to have to stay in there and pray, basically.
sentences.zh: 我们只能待在里面，基本上只能祈祷。

sentences.en: We say my daughter is a half years old and our younger is a year and a half.
sentences.zh: 我女儿才一岁半，小一点的那个才一岁半。

sentences.en: We told them they have to be quiet.
sentences.zh: 我们告诉他们必须保持安静。

sentences.en: And so for nine hours, my girls have not eaten anything.
sentences.zh: 就这样，九个小时里，我的孩子们什么都没吃。

sentences.en: The safe room, we have no electricity, we have no phone.
sentences.zh: 安全屋里没有电，也没有电话。

sentences.en: 3.30, I think it was.
sentences.zh: 我想大概是3点30分。

sentences.en: This is nine and a half hours.
sentences.zh: 这已经是九个半小时了。

sentences.en: Into the ordeal, we heard a big bang on the concrete window.
sentences.zh: 在煎熬中，我们听到混凝土窗户上传来一声巨响。

sentences.en: And we heard my father say,
sentences.zh: 我们听到我父亲说，

sentences.en: Egatti, I'm here.
sentences.zh: 埃加蒂，我在这儿。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: We opened the door, finally.
sentences.zh: 我们终于打开了门。

sentences.en: And he came in with this group of soldiers.
sentences.zh: 他带着一群士兵进来了。

sentences.en: We hugged them.
sentences.zh: 我们拥抱了他们。

sentences.en: They hugged us.
sentences.zh: 他们也拥抱了我们。

sentences.en: Then the difficult part began.
sentences.zh: 然后，困难的部分开始了。

sentences.en: They started bringing into our house families that could no longer stay in theirs.
sentences.zh: 他们开始把那些无法继续待在自己家里的家庭带到我们家。

sentences.en: Wounded people, people who don't know where their loved ones are.
sentences.zh: 受伤的人，不知道亲人在哪里的人。

sentences.en: People who heard terrorists walking inside their house.
sentences.zh: 听到恐怖分子在自己家里走动的人。

sentences.en: Something that did not happen to us.
sentences.zh: 这并没有发生在我们身上。

sentences.en: And I think is way more traumatic.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为这更具创伤性。

sentences.en: Everybody was gathered in our house.
sentences.zh: 所有人都聚集在我们家里。

sentences.en: And you saw all the pain of the people and the fear of the children.
sentences.zh: 你看到了人们所有的痛苦和孩子们的恐惧。

sentences.en: This went on for several hours.
sentences.zh: 这种情况持续了几个小时。

sentences.en: And in the middle of the night,
sentences.zh: 半夜时分，

sentences.en: the soldiers organized the bus, came and took all of us, including my father now with us, out of the kibbutz.
sentences.zh: 士兵们组织了一辆巴士，过来把我们所有人，包括现在和我们在一起的父亲，都带离了基布兹。

sentences.en: I have to say we are very, very angry and disappointed.
sentences.zh: 我必须说，我们感到非常、非常愤怒和失望。

sentences.en: Crying for help and nobody came.
sentences.zh: 哭喊着求救，却没有人来。

sentences.en: And when we were sitting there with the girls and hearing the Hamas sell outside our window,
sentences.zh: 当我们和孩子们坐在那里，听到窗外哈马斯的叫喊声时，

sentences.en: I've told me the Yom Kippur War of our lives,
sentences.zh: 我对自己说，这是我们生命中的赎罪日战争，

sentences.en: this is the Yom Kippur War of our generation.
sentences.zh: 这是我们这一代的赎罪日战争。

sentences.en: From the New York Times,
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，

sentences.en: I'm Sabrina Tavernisi, and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西（Sabrina Tavernisi），这是《每日新闻》（The Daily）。

sentences.en: Over the weekend,
sentences.zh: 周末期间，

sentences.en: Palestinian militants launched a stunning and highly coordinated invasion of Israel, rampaging through Israeli towns, killing people in their homes and on the streets,
sentences.zh: 巴勒斯坦武装分子对以色列发动了一场令人震惊且高度协调的入侵，在以色列城镇横冲直撞，在人们家中和街头杀人，

sentences.en: and taking hostages.
sentences.zh: 并劫持了人质。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Isabel Kirshner on the biggest attack against Israel in 50 years, and the all-out war that it has now prompted.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事伊莎贝尔·克什纳（Isabel Kirshner）将讲述50年来针对以色列的最大规模袭击，以及它现在引发的全面战争。

sentences.en: It's Monday, October 9th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月9日，星期一。

sentences.en: So Isabel, we all woke up Saturday morning to this unbelievable news that there had been this massive attack on Israel.
sentences.zh: 那么伊莎贝尔，周六早上我们都醒来听到了这个令人难以置信的消息，即以色列遭到了大规模袭击。

sentences.en: And over the course of the day, I was absolutely glued to my phone and to your dispatches, trying to understand what on earth was happening.
sentences.zh: 在那一天里，我一直紧盯着手机和你的报道，试图弄清楚到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: You know, this is not something we really ever see, an attack on this scale on Israeli territory.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这并不是我们真正能看到的事情，在以色列领土上发生这种规模的袭击。

sentences.en: How did the day start for you?
sentences.zh: 你的一天是怎么开始的？

sentences.en: Well, I was woken up by a phone call probably about an hour into the beginning of the attack, which began with rocket fire.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我在袭击开始大约一小时后被一个电话吵醒，袭击始于火箭弹袭击。

sentences.en: And honestly, there was such a fog of what exactly was happening at the time.
sentences.zh: 老实说，当时对于到底发生了什么，简直是一片迷雾。

sentences.en: It really took most of the day for details to emerge.
sentences.zh: 细节确实花了一整天的时间才浮出水面。

sentences.en: But as the hours unfolded, it became clear that this was a hugely coordinated invasion of Israel carried out by militants from the Gaza Strip,
sentences.zh: 但随着时间的推移，很明显这是一场由加沙地带武装分子对以色列发动的极其协调的入侵，

sentences.en: which is a Palestinian territory adjacent to Israel.
sentences.zh: 加沙地带是与以色列接壤的巴勒斯坦领土。

sentences.en: And the militants were from Hamas, the Islamic militant group that controls the Gaza Strip.
sentences.zh: 武装分子来自哈马斯，这是一个控制加沙地带的伊斯兰武装组织。

sentences.en: And those militants broke easily through the fortifications on the border, reaching more than 10 miles into Israeli territory, taking over houses, taking over whole villages,
sentences.zh: 这些武装分子轻易突破了边境的防御工事，深入以色列领土超过10英里，占领了房屋，占领了整个村庄，

sentences.en: coming by air, land and sea.
sentences.zh: 通过空中、陆地和海上进入。

sentences.en: And as the events unfolded and the day went on, it became clear that this was the broadest, biggest invasion of Israeli territory in 50 years.
sentences.zh: 随着事件的发展和一天的过去，很明显这是50年来对以色列领土最广泛、最大规模的入侵。

sentences.en: Okay, so let's start to unpack this.
sentences.zh: 好的，让我们开始剖析这件事。

sentences.en: When did it begin and how did it begin?
sentences.zh: 它是什么时候开始的，又是如何开始的？

sentences.en: So it began at about 6.30 in the morning.
sentences.zh: 它大约在早上6点30分开始。

sentences.en: It was a Saturday, the day of the Sabbath here, when most people would have been asleep.
sentences.zh: 那天是星期六，这里的安息日，大多数人本应还在睡觉。

sentences.en: It was also a Jewish holiday of Sukkot, Simchat Torah, which is usually a very festive day, which caps the high holy days of the autumn season.
sentences.zh: 这也是犹太节日住棚节（Sukkot）和妥拉节（Simchat Torah），这通常是一个非常喜庆的日子，标志着秋季高级圣日的结束。

sentences.en: And people had really been gearing up for, you know, a nice weekend and woke up to barrages of rocket fire,
sentences.zh: 人们本来都在为美好的周末做准备，却在火箭弹的轰炸声中醒来，

sentences.en: sirens going off all over the country.
sentences.zh: 全国各地的警报声响起。

sentences.en: They were going off in Tel Aviv.
sentences.zh: 特拉维夫响起了警报。

sentences.en: They were going off in central Jerusalem.
sentences.zh: 耶路撒冷市中心也响起了警报。

sentences.en: As the morning went on, there were scenes emerging on TV and social media of tractors just crashing through the border fence on the Gaza border.
sentences.zh: 随着早晨的推移，电视和社交媒体上出现了拖拉机撞破加沙边境围栏的画面。

sentences.en: We saw columns of vehicles speeding through with nobody there to stop them.
sentences.zh: 我们看到车队疾驰而过，没有人阻止他们。

sentences.en: They were headed to the communities along the border, villages, kibbutzim, and small cooperative villages.
sentences.zh: 他们前往边境沿线的社区、村庄、基布兹和小型合作村庄。

sentences.en: Once they reached these communities and towns,
sentences.zh: 一旦他们到达这些社区和城镇，

sentences.en: they literally went house to house and started knocking on doors or shooting their way in.
sentences.zh: 他们真的挨家挨户地敲门，或者开枪闯入。

sentences.en: And we began to see the most terrifying scenes on TV of people calling in,
sentences.zh: 我们开始在电视上看到最可怕的场景，人们打来电话，

sentences.en: whispering and begging for help,
sentences.zh: 低声哀求帮助，

sentences.en: saying, I can hear the gunmen, they're outside my house, or in some cases they're inside my house.
sentences.zh: 说，我能听到枪手的声音，他们在我的房子外面，或者在某些情况下，他们在我的房子里面。

sentences.en: Maybe they killed them, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 也许他们杀了他们，我不知道。

sentences.en: And we're talking here about families, grandparents, people with young children.
sentences.zh: 我们在这里谈论的是家庭、祖父母、带着小孩的人。

sentences.en: And then it began to emerge
sentences.zh: 然后开始出现消息，

sentences.en: that there had also been an all-night rave not far from the Gaza border.
sentences.zh: 在离加沙边境不远的地方还有一场通宵狂欢派对。

sentences.en: Whoever tried to run away, they were shooting him from both sides.
sentences.zh: 任何试图逃跑的人，他们都会从两边向他射击。

sentences.en: And there were about 2,000 young Israelis who'd spent the night there and then found themselves surrounded by gunmen.
sentences.zh: 大约有2000名年轻的以色列人在那里过夜，然后发现自己被枪手包围了。

sentences.en: The terrorists, they took out people from the car and just gunned them down.
sentences.zh: 恐怖分子把人从车里拉出来，直接开枪打死。

sentences.en: Shooting into their cars, shooting at them as they ran on foot.
sentences.zh: 向他们的车里射击，在他们步行逃跑时向他们射击。

sentences.en: All the way people were dying, all the way on the road.
sentences.zh: 一路上都有人在死去，整条路上都是。

sentences.en: Young people.
sentences.zh: 年轻人。

sentences.en: So best were to hide.
sentences.zh: 所以最好躲起来。

sentences.en: There were people hiding in bushes and among the trees for hours in this open rural area being hunted by these gunmen.
sentences.zh: 在这个开阔的农村地区，有人在灌木丛和树木中躲藏了几个小时，被这些枪手追捕。

sentences.en: And it appears that both in the villages along the Gaza border and at the rave, the militants were picking up sometimes injured Israelis and in many cases uninjured Israelis
sentences.zh: 看来，无论是在加沙边境的村庄还是在狂欢派对上，武装分子都在抓捕受伤的以色列人，在许多情况下甚至是未受伤的以色列人，

sentences.en: and just taking them into Gaza as hostages.
sentences.zh: 并把他们作为人质带进加沙。

sentences.en: There were whole families, there were young couples, there were elderly people.
sentences.zh: 有整个家庭，有年轻夫妇，有老人。

sentences.en: This was a stunning and shocking scenario, a nightmare scenario for Israelis.
sentences.zh: 这是一个令人震惊和震撼的场景，对以色列人来说是一个噩梦般的场景。

sentences.en: Very soon after the rocket fire of Saturday morning and the invasion of the gunmen, the Israeli military puts planes in the sky and starts to strike in Gaza, across the Gaza Strip.
sentences.zh: 在周六早上的火箭弹袭击和枪手入侵后不久，以色列军方派出飞机升空，开始在加沙地带进行打击。

sentences.en: And the government says it's trying to target cells and launching pads where the rockets are being fired from.
sentences.zh: 政府表示，它试图瞄准火箭弹发射的据点和发射台。

sentences.en: But we know the strikes are deadly and often inflict casualties on Palestinian civilians there.
sentences.zh: 但我们知道这些打击是致命的，往往会造成那里的巴勒斯坦平民伤亡。

sentences.en: And soon after that,
sentences.zh: 此后不久，

sentences.en: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu comes on television with a recorded statement and announces that Israel is calling up reserves for a retaliatory offensive in Gaza
sentences.zh: 总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡在电视上发表录音声明，宣布以色列正在召集预备役部队对加沙进行报复性进攻，

sentences.en: and says that we are at war.
sentences.zh: 并说我们处于战争状态。

sentences.en: So this is just an extraordinary attack on so many levels.
sentences.zh: 所以这在很多层面上都是一次非同寻常的袭击。

sentences.en: Historic and a complete shock.
sentences.zh: 具有历史意义，而且完全令人震惊。

sentences.en: Do we have any sense of how this happened?
sentences.zh: 我们对这件事是如何发生的有什么了解吗？

sentences.en: How was Hamas able to pull this off?
sentences.zh: 哈马斯是如何做到这一点的？

sentences.en: Well, that's the big question that everybody here is now asking because this was a complete surprise.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是这里每个人现在都在问的大问题，因为这完全是一个意外。

sentences.en: Israel was caught completely off guard.
sentences.zh: 以色列完全被打了个措手不及。

sentences.en: It's not clear how Hamas did this, but there are hints that from
sentences.zh: 目前还不清楚哈马斯是如何做到这一点的，但有迹象表明，

sentences.en: Israeli officials now that there's been some Iranian help.
sentences.zh: 以色列官员现在表示，这其中有一些伊朗的帮助。

sentences.en: We know that Iran has given logistical support to Hamas for years and Hamas has just grown in sophistication in terms of its military machine.
sentences.zh: 我们知道伊朗多年来一直为哈马斯提供后勤支持，哈马斯的军事机器也变得越来越复杂。

sentences.en: We've seen over the years its rockets reaching further and further into Israel, but nothing on a scale like this because this was clearly such a well-planned and coordinated
sentences.zh: 多年来，我们看到它的火箭弹射程越来越远，深入以色列境内，但从未达到这种规模，因为这显然是一次计划周密、协调一致的

sentences.en: and multi-pronged attack and how that could have all happened without Israel noticing is the question that everybody here is now asking.
sentences.zh: 多管齐下的袭击，而这一切怎么可能在以色列毫无察觉的情况下发生，是这里每个人现在都在问的问题。

sentences.en: Well, let's talk about that.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我们谈谈这个。

sentences.en: Do we have a sense yet of how Israel didn't see this coming?
sentences.zh: 我们是否已经感觉到以色列为什么没有预见到这一点？

sentences.en: Well, first of all, people are baffled because Israel has such a vaunted
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先，人们感到困惑，因为以色列拥有如此自诩的

sentences.en: intelligence apparatus.
sentences.zh: 情报机构。

sentences.en: You know, so much has been invested in that border fence, in the fortifications.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在边境围栏和防御工事上投入了太多资金。

sentences.en: For years, you know,
sentences.zh: 多年来，你知道，

sentences.en: Israel was building a multi-billion shekel barrier that reaches underground in order to stop
sentences.zh: 以色列一直在建造一道价值数十亿谢克尔的屏障，深入地下，以阻止

sentences.en: Hamas militants or other militant groups coming into
sentences.zh: 哈马斯武装分子或其他武装组织通过地下隧道进入

sentences.en: Israeli territory through underground tunnels.
sentences.zh: 以色列领土。

sentences.en: This is an incredibly sophisticated structure with sensors, cameras, it's being watched all the time, there are usually blimps in the air.
sentences.zh: 这是一个极其复杂的结构，有传感器、摄像头，一直有人在监视，空中通常还有飞艇。

sentences.en: I mean, the fact that this was happening all along the fence and that these forces, heavily armed forces, were just driving straight through overland, not underground,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，事实上这一切一直沿着围栏发生，而这些部队，全副武装的部队，只是直接从陆路开车穿过，而不是从地下，

sentences.en: and reaching miles into Israeli territory and nobody was there to stop them.
sentences.zh: 并深入以色列领土数英里，却没有人阻止他们。

sentences.en: I mean, this was just an incredible failure.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这简直是一次令人难以置信的失败。

sentences.en: Israel was caught totally off guard.
sentences.zh: 以色列完全被打了个措手不及。

sentences.en: Many people here are saying
sentences.zh: 这里很多人都在说

sentences.en: Israel just took its eye off the ball and in fact the focus of the last few months for the military has been the West Bank, the occupied West Bank, which is the other
sentences.zh: 以色列只是放松了警惕，事实上，过去几个月军方的重点一直是西岸，被占领的西岸，这是另一个

sentences.en: major territory with a population of millions of Palestinians and hundreds of thousands of Jewish settlers living among them and where we've seen bursts of violence and increasing
sentences.zh: 拥有数百万巴勒斯坦人口和数十万居住在其中的犹太定居者的主要领土，我们在过去几个月里看到了那里的暴力事件和摩擦不断增加。

sentences.en: friction over the last few months.
sentences.zh: 所以他们根本没预见到这一点。

sentences.en: And so they just didn't see this coming.
sentences.zh: 所以他们完全被蒙蔽了。

sentences.en: So they were totally blindsided.
sentences.zh: 绝对是，绝对是。
